tooling.message:
docs(guidance): preview of the first version through a draft pull request

## Intent

The first version lived on work without a preview until it was published, so the creator had to merge into main to see it. The creator should see the current state while the app is built.

## Key changes

- In Code the agent opens a draft pull request work → main after the generated app's first commit and pushes work after each task, so the existing preview job shows the current state.
- The creator gets the link to the preview once; the publish checkpoint links it.
